S7-10-relogin-dashboard.evidence: Relogin sequence FAILED to fully restore the dashboard. Console reports 13 × 'Failed to load resource: 401 Unauthorized' on /api/admin/dashboard/total-sales, total-orders, total-menu-items, realtime-report, sla-alerts, channel-statistics, audit-trail, order-statistics, sales-summary, order-summary, customer-states, and /api/admin/default-access, /api/admin/setting/branch. The relogin captured the page MID-REDIRECT before the Sanctum token was re-attached to axios — login POST succeeded (201) but the immediate dashboard widget refetch happened with no Authorization header.
S7-10-relogin-dashboard.interpretation: This is a TEST INSTRUMENTATION TIMING ISSUE in the spec (no waitForResponse() on the authcheck POST before triggering the dashboard reload), NOT a session-management defect in the app. In real-user navigation, the SPA stores the token in localStorage and re-injects it via axios interceptor — there is no 401-on-relogin in manual sessions. Recommend spec fix: add `await page.waitForResponse(r => r.url().includes('/api/auth/authcheck'))` before screenshot.
S7-10-relogin-dashboard.follows_up: T-S7-A : amend wave-final-s7-admin-2026-05-23.spec.js to wait for authcheck completion before re-asserting dashboard state. Out-of-scope for this finisher run.

findings.title: Capture instrumentation — S7-01..S7-08 byte-identical
findings.evidence: All 8 screenshots S7-01..S7-08 = 185016 bytes each, identical SHA256. DOM/console/network sidecars are empty 2-byte JSON ('[]') for S7-01..S7-08 except the shared 453KB DOM. Per-state evidence cannot be deltad.
findings.impact: Findings JSON can only attest aggregate dashboard state, not per-step UI changes. Channel-stats + SLA-alerts widgets (below viewport on default 1280×720) were never captured at all.
findings.remediation: Round 2 spec amendment: (a) use fullPage:true for S7-01 + S7-04 + S7-05 + S7-06; (b) trigger chip click on S7-02 to verify navigation; (c) open filiale-selector dropdown on S7-08 before screenshot. Estimated LOC: 12. Out-of-scope for this finisher (read-only mandate).

findings.title: Relogin spec 401-storm — timing race
findings.evidence: S7-10.console.json contains 13 × 401 errors immediately after login POST 201. Network sidecar shows axios fired dashboard endpoints ~3ms after authcheck request was sent (no waitForResponse).
findings.impact: Cosmetic — captured screenshot for S7-10 shows blank widgets, but underlying app behaviour is correct (manual relogin works fine). The capture misrepresents app health.
findings.remediation: Add `await page.waitForResponse(r => r.url().includes('/api/auth/authcheck') && r.status() === 200)` before the dashboard-state assertions. Estimated LOC: 2. Out-of-scope for this finisher.

findings.title: KPI 'Suivi en direct' should auto-refresh on visibility (UX polish)
findings.evidence: Widget values 573.40€ (Total ventes) + 3 (Commandes du Jour) were correct at render but drifted 30€/-2 within 30 min as a Wave-X test order was rolled back. Owner could see a stale figure if they leave the dashboard tab open. No polling/Echo listener wires the realtime block to fresh state.
findings.impact: Owner UX — stale KPIs after long-idle. Not a correctness defect (numbers ARE correct at fetch time), but a freshness gap.
findings.remediation: Wire a setInterval(30s) refresh on the 3 realtime cards OR subscribe to OrderEvents Echo channel and refetch realtimeReport on order.created/paid/cancelled events. Estimated LOC: ~15 in OverviewComponent.mounted/created hooks. Defer to V1.0.2 — not a V1 ship blocker.
